content: Human-labeling session — f11-pivot-on-scout:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a perception-and-counter operation against a more ambiguous enemy posture. Your western base at (8,20) holds the full production stack (Construction Yard, Power Plant, Refinery, Barracks, War Factory, Helipad, Shipyard, Service Depot) and two starter Harvesters. A starter Jeep sits forward at (20,20). Three ore patches sit east of the refinery. Cash on hand: $7000. The enemy has TWO forward production buildings visible — a Barracks at (80,18) and a Helipad at (80,22) — but only ONE is actually producing the threat. Drive your jeep east to observe which arm is active, produce the matching counter (at least three of the right unit type), then raze at least one enemy production building — all within about 100 turns. Keep your western Construction Yard standing.
